legacy.welcomeDetail: Design, manufacture, and manage your projects in one place.
legacy.emptyProjects: No projects yet. Create a project to start designing.
legacy.marketplaceDetail: Discover and purchase high-quality CAD components, drawings, and G-code programs
legacy.marketplaceGap: Marketplace browsing, listings, purchases, and seller analytics are not exposed by the desktop API yet. No catalog or purchase status can be verified.
legacy.purchaseWarning: A return URL is not proof of payment. Purchase confirmation and downloads require a verified purchase from the server.
legacy.chatGap: Conversations, messages, attachments, and group creation are not exposed by the desktop API yet. Sending is unavailable; organization members below are loaded from the server.
legacy.aiGap: AI sessions and streaming are not exposed by the typed desktop client yet. Prompts cannot be sent from this screen.
legacy.aiPrompt: Ask about your design or manufacturing workflow
legacy.aiSafety: Review generated geometry and G-code before running a machine.
legacy.profileGap: The desktop API does not expose the current user profile or profile updates. Identity details are not inferred from project ownership.
legacy.authGap: Password sign-in, account registration, two-factor verification, and magic-link consumption are not exposed by the typed desktop API. Use the supported email flows instead.
legacy.noMembers: No members returned by the server.
legacy.name: Name
legacy.componentGap: Component metadata is editable. Geometry editing, previews, predefined templates, import/export, and deletion still require the full component editor.
legacy.componentSelect: Select a project to load its components from the server.
